days.top_line: Americans voted on 3 November 2026, but control of Congress was still unknown when we researched this. An Indian sailor was killed off Oman on 2 November when an aerial object hit his ship.
Iran has squeezed its ceasefire plan into two days, and a report says Netanyahu urged Trump to strike after 3 November. Americans vote in the midterms that day, but full results may take weeks.
Iran says Hormuz could reopen within two days if the US meets its conditions, while Trump threatens new strikes. Cyclone Murasu is expected to hit land near Ongole overnight.
